scripts.verify: npm run verify:format && npm run verify:styles && npm run verify:landing && npm run verify:i18n && npm run verify:docs && npm run verify:angular && npm run verify:layout && npm run verify:deps && npm run verify:swift && npm run verify:rust && npm run verify:coverage
scripts.verify:deps: cargo deny --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml check advisories bans licenses sources
scripts.verify:swift: node scripts/check-native.mjs --selftest && node scripts/check-native.mjs && swift format lint --strict --recursive src-tauri/native/Sources src-tauri/native/Tests && swift test --package-path src-tauri/native
scripts.verify:coverage: cargo llvm-cov --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --json --summary-only --ignore-filename-regex '(^|/)tests/' --output-path src-tauri/target/coverage.json && node scripts/check-coverage.mjs --selftest && node scripts/check-coverage.mjs src-tauri/target/coverage.json
scripts.verify:docs: npm run verify:comments && compodoc -p tsconfig.json -d docs/api/angular --coverageTest 76 --coverageTestThresholdFail true && RUSTDOCFLAGS="-D warnings" cargo doc --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --no-deps --document-private-items
scripts.docs: npm run docs:angular && npm run docs:rust
scripts.docs:rust: cargo doc --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --no-deps --document-private-items && rm -rf docs/api/rust && mkdir -p docs/api && cp -R src-tauri/target/doc docs/api/rust
scripts.verify:rust: cargo fmt --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --check && cargo clippy --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo test --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml && cargo test --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --release
scripts.clean: rm -rf src-tauri/target/debug src-tauri/target/release src-tauri/target/doc .angular dist coverage docs/api
scripts.clean:deep: npm run clean && rm -rf src-tauri/target src-tauri/native/.build
